title: What Malaysia pays, by industry
gapNote: Seconds held after each voice line ends, before the next shot cuts.

endCard.title: What Malaysia pays, by industry
endCard.source: Data: Department of Statistics Malaysia, Salaries and Wages Survey. CC BY 4.0.

shots.claim: Education pays twice the national median
shots.caption: The lift climbs from the national median to the education median.

shots.claim: Two in three workers are in an industry that pays below the median
shots.caption: The workforce forks at the median. Most of it goes left.

shots.claim: It narrowed for a decade, broke in 2020, and never got back to 2019
shots.caption: The walls are the spread. In 2020 they slam apart.

shots.claim: The public sector climbed. Resource and finance fell.
shots.caption: Nineteen lift cars, one year counter.

shots.claim: Four industries carry more than half the wage bill
shots.caption: Lights fill in proportion to each industry's share of the bill.

shots.claim: Where pay is lowest, the average sits furthest above the typical wage
shots.caption: The lift stops at the median, then continues to the mean.
